record.title: Lout of Count's Family (Novel)
record.description:
**A man who wants nothing more than to kick back and relax must use his wit and wiles to survive the fantasy novel he’s fallen into.**

Ever dreamt of waking up inside a novel? For Kim Roksu, this dream becomes reality when he finds himself in the shoes of Cale Henituse, the lazy, wine-loving son of a count—and punching bag for the novel’s destined hero. Determined to dodge his grim fate, this new Cale Henituse vows to rewrite his story, aiming for a life of leisure far from heroic deeds and inevitable beatdowns.

But the path to a peaceful life is twisted by irony. As Cale plots his escape from destiny, he inadvertently gathers a motley crew of magical allies—including a haughty baby dragon and two mischievous kitten shapeshifters. Every attempt to avoid heroism entangles him further in a whirlwind of unforeseen adventures, proving that sometimes the best heroes are the ones who resist the call.

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*

record.title: Trash in the Trash Bin
record.description:
Joon-woo hates anything burdensome and just wants to enjoy a variety of pleasures. His line has always been: “As long as you’re okay with me seeing other people, I’ll date you.” But every time, that’s led to being dumped with a “trash” label and another relationship cut short. One day, he matches with Seok-min on an app and has an incredibly satisfying night with him. The next day, Joon-woo discovers that Seok-min is actually a TA in his department. From then on, he finds himself being pulled along by Seok-min—slowly losing the free-spirited lifestyle he thought he’d never give up.

record.description:
The story centers around Kie Hirano, a 30-year old female office worker with a large-scale imagination. She gets to know Mitsumasa Koudai, a handsome colleague, who also happens to be a telepath who can read people's thoughts. Mitsumasa is charmed by Kie's personality, and they start a relationship. Mitsumasa's mother Yuuko judges Kie to be unfit to marry her son, but the family matriarch Ann makes Yuuko retract the statement. Now Ann teaches Kie how to be a proper lady, and Kie's life becomes intertwined with the Koudai family.

record.title: Mimurake no Musuko
record.description:
In the *Mimurake no Musuko* series:

V.1 - *Mimurake no Musuko* (Son of the Mimura Family)  
A story set in countryside, about two childhood friends Yumi and Toshi. While going through puberty Toshi developes unresolved feelings for Yumi. One day Toshi meets Yumi’s older brother Sumi and is lured into a sexual relationship with him. And so the love triangle begins...

V.2 - *Deki no Waruiko* (Clumsy Child)  
The second son of the established rural Mimura family, Yumi, and Toshi are the closest of friends. Then one day, Yumi comes to know of Toshi's intimate relationship with Yumi's older brother, Sumi. After hearing Toshi confess that he likes Sumi, a shocked Yumi makes a plan to tear them apart, but...

V.3 - *Umareboshi* (Newborn Star)  
The second son of the established rural Mimura family, Yumi, and Toshi are the closest of friends. Even though their mutual feelings emerged as they held each other, the couple had a misunderstanding.... A heartbroken Yumi goes back alone to their hometown for the holidays, where the cherry blossoms flutter. But then, though he was able to separate himself quickly, all he can think about is Toshi. Yumi and Toshi’s story in the “Son of Mimura Family” series is at its exciting climax!

[English publication via Renta!](http://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/77674/)
